ads.text:
☀️ Give Your Family the Power of a Brighter Tomorrow!

A solar-powered home means more than just generating electricity. It's about smarter energy choices, reduced electricity expenses, and a cleaner environment for the next generation.

With Rooftop Solar, You Can:

✔ Reduce dependence on conventional electricity.

✔ Enjoy long-term electricity bill savings.

✔ Explore government subsidy benefits.

✔ Make your home more energy-efficient.

✔ Contribute towards a greener environment.

Let your rooftop become a source of power and savings.

📍 Mysuru & Nearby Cities.

Choose Solar. Choose a Sustainable Future. Choose Raga Renewable Energy.

ad_library.summary: One active Meta ad card captured on 2026-11-23; this is a sample, not necessarily the total. Google Ads activity was not checked.

site_audit.scope_note: The ad links to the Instagram profile, not the website. The homepage was reviewed separately. Unobserved source tags remain unknown and no form submission or event firing was tested.

issues: The captured ad links to the Instagram profile; test how enquiries are received and followed up there.
A homepage testimonial attributed to John Doe refers to SunBright Energy; verify or remove this apparent placeholder.
Homepage counter text included 0+ years and 4% satisfaction in the fetched page; verify display and data in a browser.

site_evidence.note: Partial homepage source review; runtime behavior and ad destination not inferred.

promise_gap: Ad: rooftop solar and government subsidy benefits.
The captured ad links to Instagram. The separately reviewed website describes rooftop solutions and up to ₹78,000 in savings; eligibility was not verified.
The site lists a Mysuru address and a Bengaluru address; actual service coverage should be confirmed.
recommended_steps: Check profile, message handling and follow-up time.
Verify or remove the John Doe / SunBright Energy quote.
Test the homepage counters in a real browser and correct any stale values.
Test a controlled submission and measurement with permission.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
